name: GASIUS
introduction: For the London-based graphic designer Gasius, graffiti became his habit at twelve, which led to Gasface, his graffiti brand launched in 1993. The garments have been distributed only to skate shops such as Slam City Skates. In 1998, Gasius took the position as a head graphic designer at Maharishi and carried it out for seven years. Afterwards, he left it to focus on his own artist activities. He created his street wear label Gasius, the same as his artist name, whose items have been dealt with limited boutiques all over the world including UK’s GoodHood, Paris' Colette, and Amasterdam’s 290Sqm.
